@Entry
@Component
struct DocumentScanner {
  @State authStatus: string = 'Not Authenticated'
  @State scannedDocument: string = 'scanned_image'

  checkBiometricAuth() {
    this.authStatus = 'Authenticating...'
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.authStatus = 'Authenticated'
    }, 2000)
  }

  build() {
    Column({ space: 20 }) {
      Row() {
        Text('Home')
          .fontSize(16)
          .fontColor(Color.Gray)
        Text('>')
          .fontSize(16)
          .margin({ left: 8, right: 8 })
          .fontColor(Color.Gray)
        Text('Scanner')
          .fontSize(16)
          .fontColor(Color.Black)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(10)
      .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Start)

      Text('Document Scanner')
        .fontSize(24)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)

      Button('Biometric Auth')
        .onClick(() => this.checkBiometricAuth())
        .width('80%')
        .height(40)
        .backgroundColor('#007AFF')
        .fontColor(Color.White)

      Text(`Status: ${this.authStatus}`)
        .fontSize(16)

      Divider()
        .strokeWidth(2)
        .color(Color.Gray)
        .margin({ top: 20, bottom: 20 })

      Image(this.scannedDocument)
        .width('90%')
        .height(400)
        .objectFit(ImageFit.Contain)
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .padding(20)
    .backgroundColor(Color.White)
  }
}

@Entry
@Component
struct CalculatorApp {
  @State displayText: string = '0'
  @State firstOperand: number = 0
  @State secondOperand: number = 0
  @State operation: string = ''
  @State showDialog: boolean = false
  @State dialogMessage: string = ''

  build() {
    Column({ space: 10 }) {
      Text(this.displayText)
        .fontSize(40)
        .width('100%')
        .textAlign(TextAlign.End)
        .padding(10)

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('7')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('7'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('8')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('8'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('9')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('9'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('÷')
          .onClick(() => this.setOperation('/'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
      }

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('4')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('4'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('5')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('5'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('6')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('6'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('×')
          .onClick(() => this.setOperation('*'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
      }

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('1')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('1'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('2')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('2'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('3')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('3'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('-')
          .onClick(() => this.setOperation('-'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
      }

      Row({ space: 10 }) {
        Button('0')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('0'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('.')
          .onClick(() => this.appendNumber('.'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('C')
          .onClick(() => this.clear())
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
        Button('+')
          .onClick(() => this.setOperation('+'))
          .width('25%')
          .height(60)
      }

      Button('=')
        .onClick(() => this.calculate())
        .width('100%')
        .height(60)
        .margin({ top: 10 })

      if (this.showDialog) {
        Column() {
          Text(this.dialogMessage)
            .fontSize(20)
            .margin({ bottom: 20 })
          Row({ space: 10 }) {
            Button('Cancel')
              .onClick(() => {
                this.showDialog = false
              })
              .width('50%')
            Button('Confirm')
              .onClick(() => {
                this.showDialog = false
                this.executeOperation()
              })
              .width('50%')
          }
        }
        .width('80%')
        .padding(20)
        .backgroundColor('#ffffff')
        .borderRadius(10)
      }
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .padding(20)
  }

  appendNumber(num: string) {
    if (this.displayText === '0' || this.displayText === 'Error') {
      this.displayText = num
    } else {
      this.displayText += num
    }
  }

  setOperation(op: string) {
    this.firstOperand = parseFloat(this.displayText)
    this.operation = op
    this.displayText = '0'
  }

  calculate() {
    this.secondOperand = parseFloat(this.displayText)
    this.dialogMessage = `Perform ${this.firstOperand} ${this.operation} ${this.secondOperand}?`
    this.showDialog = true
  }

  executeOperation() {
    let result: number
    switch (this.operation) {
      case '+':
        result = this.firstOperand + this.secondOperand
        break
      case '-':
        result = this.firstOperand - this.secondOperand
        break
      case '*':
        result = this.firstOperand * this.secondOperand
        break
      case '/':
        result = this.firstOperand / this.secondOperand
        break
      default:
        result = 0
    }
    this.displayText = result.toString()
  }

  clear() {
    this.displayText = '0'
    this.firstOperand = 0
    this.secondOperand = 0
    this.operation = ''
  }
}

@Entry
@Component
struct GradientShapesCanvas {
  private settings: RenderingContextSettings = new RenderingContextSettings(true)
  private context: CanvasRenderingContext2D = new CanvasRenderingContext2D(this.settings)

  build() {
    Flex({ direction: FlexDirection.Column, alignItems: ItemAlign.Center, justifyContent: FlexAlign.Center }) {
      Canvas(this.context)
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#ffffff')
        .onReady(() => {
          // Draw a rounded rectangle with gradient fill and stroke
          let rectGradient = this.context.createLinearGradient(50, 50, 250, 150)
          rectGradient.addColorStop(0.0, '#ff0000')
          rectGradient.addColorStop(1.0, '#0000ff')
          this.context.fillStyle = rectGradient
          this.context.beginPath()
          // Draw rounded rectangle manually
          let x = 50, y = 50, width = 200, height = 100, radius = 20
          this.context.moveTo(x + radius, y)
          this.context.lineTo(x + width - radius, y)
          this.context.arc(x + width - radius, y + radius, radius, 0, Math.PI / 2)
          this.context.lineTo(x + width, y + height - radius)
          this.context.arc(x + width - radius, y + height - radius, radius, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI)
          this.context.lineTo(x + radius, y + height)
          this.context.arc(x + radius, y + height - radius, radius, Math.PI, 3 * Math.PI / 2)
          this.context.lineTo(x, y + radius)
          this.context.arc(x + radius, y + radius, radius, 3 * Math.PI / 2, 2 * Math.PI)
          this.context.closePath()
          this.context.fill()
          this.context.lineWidth = 5
          this.context.strokeStyle = '#00ff00'
          this.context.stroke()

          // Draw a circle with radial gradient fill and stroke
          let circleGradient = this.context.createRadialGradient(150, 300, 50, 150, 300, 100)
          circleGradient.addColorStop(0.0, '#ffff00')
          circleGradient.addColorStop(1.0, '#ff00ff')
          this.context.beginPath()
          this.context.arc(150, 300, 80, 0, 2 * Math.PI)
          this.context.fillStyle = circleGradient
          this.context.fill()
          this.context.lineWidth = 5
          this.context.strokeStyle = '#0000ff'
          this.context.stroke()

          // Draw a triangle with gradient fill and stroke
          let triangleGradient = this.context.createLinearGradient(250, 400, 450, 500)
          triangleGradient.addColorStop(0.0, '#00ff00')
          triangleGradient.addColorStop(1.0, '#0000ff')
          this.context.beginPath()
          this.context.moveTo(250, 500)
          this.context.lineTo(350, 400)
          this.context.lineTo(450, 500)
          this.context.closePath()
          this.context.fillStyle = triangleGradient
          this.context.fill()
          this.context.lineWidth = 5
          this.context.strokeStyle = '#ff0000'
          this.context.stroke()

          // Draw a star with gradient fill and stroke
          let starGradient = this.context.createLinearGradient(150, 550, 350, 650)
          starGradient.addColorStop(0.0, '#ff6600')
          starGradient.addColorStop(1.0, '#9900cc')
          this.context.beginPath()
          this.context.moveTo(175, 575)
          this.context.lineTo(190, 620)
          this.context.lineTo(150, 590)
          this.context.lineTo(200, 590)
          this.context.lineTo(160, 620)
          this.context.closePath()
          this.context.fillStyle = starGradient
          this.context.fill()
          this.context.lineWidth = 3
          this.context.strokeStyle = '#330066'
          this.context.stroke()
        })
    }

  }
}

@Entry
@Component
struct AccessibilityConfig {
  build() {
    Column() {
      Text('Accessibility Demo')
        .fontSize(24)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .accessibilityLevel('1')
        .accessibilityTextHint('Application title for accessibility demonstration')
        .accessibilityGroup(true)

      Text('Configure your accessibility settings below')
        .fontSize(18)
        .margin({ top: 20 })
        .accessibilityLevel('2')
        .accessibilityTextHint('Instructions for setting up accessibility')
        .accessibilityGroup(true)

      Image($r('app.media.app_icon'))
        .width(100)
        .height(100)
        .margin({ top: 20 })
        .accessibilityLevel('1')
        .accessibilityTextHint('Logo of the application')
        .accessibilityGroup(true)

      Button('Increase Text Size')
        .margin({ top: 20 })
        .onClick(() => {
          console.info('Text size increased');
        })
        .accessibilityLevel('1')
        .accessibilityTextHint('Press to increase text size')
        .accessibilityGroup(true)

      Button('Enable Screen Reader')
        .margin({ top: 20 })
        .onClick(() => {
          console.info('Screen reader enabled');
        })
        .accessibilityLevel('1')
        .accessibilityTextHint('Press to enable screen reader')
        .accessibilityGroup(true)

      Toggle({ type: ToggleType.Switch })
        .margin({ top: 30 })
        .accessibilityLevel('2')
        .accessibilityTextHint('Toggle for dark mode')
        .accessibilityGroup(true)
    }
    .padding(20)
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .accessibilityLevel('1')
    .accessibilityTextHint('Main container for accessibility settings')
  }
}

final_code:
@Entry
@Component
struct PolygonLineJoinExample {
  private settings: RenderingContextSettings = new RenderingContextSettings(true)
  private context: CanvasRenderingContext2D = new CanvasRenderingContext2D(this.settings)

  build() {
    Flex({ direction: FlexDirection.Column, alignItems: ItemAlign.Center, justifyContent: FlexAlign.Center }) {
      Canvas(this.context)
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#ffffff')
        .onReady(() => {
          // Draw polygons with different line join styles
          this.context.beginPath()
          this.context.lineWidth = 10
          this.context.lineJoin = 'miter'
          this.context.moveTo(50, 50)
          this.context.lineTo(150, 50)
          this.context.lineTo(150, 150)
          this.context.lineTo(50, 150)
          this.context.closePath()
          this.context.stroke()

          this.context.beginPath()
          this.context.lineJoin = 'round'
          this.context.moveTo(200, 50)
          this.context.lineTo(300, 50)
          this.context.lineTo(300, 150)
          this.context.lineTo(200, 150)
          this.context.closePath()
          this.context.stroke()

          this.context.beginPath()
          this.context.lineJoin = 'bevel'
          this.context.moveTo(350, 50)
          this.context.lineTo(450, 50)
          this.context.lineTo(450, 150)
          this.context.lineTo(350, 150)
          this.context.closePath()
          this.context.stroke()
        })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
  }
}

@Entry
@Component
struct Component3DEnvironment {

    Column() {

        .fontSize(24)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .width('100%')
        .padding(10)
        .backgroundColor('#D2B48C')

        Text(`Temperature: ${this.temperature}°C`)
          .fontSize(18)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .backgroundColor('#F5DEB3')
          .height('100%')

        Text(`Humidity: ${this.humidity}%`)
          .fontSize(18)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .backgroundColor('#D2B48C')
          .height('100%')

        Text(`Light: ${this.light} Lux`)
          .fontSize(18)
          .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .backgroundColor('#F5DEB3')
          .height('100%')
      }
      .height('15%')
      .width('100%')
      .padding(10)

      Row() {
        Button('Increase Temp')
          .onClick(() => { this.temperature += 1; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)

        Button('Decrease Temp')
          .onClick(() => { this.temperature -= 1; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(5)

      Row() {
        Button('Increase Humid')
          .onClick(() => { this.humidity += 1; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)

        Button('Decrease Humid')
          .onClick(() => { this.humidity -= 1; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(5)

      Row() {
        Button('More Light')
          .onClick(() => { this.light += 10; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)

        Button('Less Light')
          .onClick(() => { this.light -= 10; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(5)

      Text('Adjust Complexity')
        .fontSize(20)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .width('100%')
        .padding(10)
        .backgroundColor('#D2B48C')

      Row() {
        Button('Low')
          .onClick(() => { this.complexity = 1; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)

        Button('Medium')
          .onClick(() => { this.complexity = 2; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)

        Button('High')
          .onClick(() => { this.complexity = 3; })
          .layoutWeight(1)
          .margin(5)
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(5)

      Column() {
        if (this.complexity === 1) {
          Image($r('app.media.app_icon'))
            .width('90%')
            .height(200)
            .backgroundColor('#333333')
            .borderRadius(10)
        } else if (this.complexity === 2) {
          Image($r('app.media.app_icon'))
            .width('90%')
            .height(200)
            .backgroundColor('#666666')
            .borderRadius(10)
        } else {
          Image($r('app.media.app_icon'))
            .width('90%')
            .height(200)
            .backgroundColor('#999999')
            .borderRadius(10)
        }
      }
      .width('100%')
      .padding(10)
    }

    .height('100%')
    .backgroundColor('#EEE8AA')
  }
}

        .margin({ top: 20 })

        .fontColor(Color.Black)
        .margin({ top: 10 })

        .fontSize(16)
        .fontColor(Color.Black)
        .margin({ top: 10 })

        .strokeWidth(1)
        .color(Color.Gray)
        .margin({ top: 20, bottom: 20 })

      Text('Current Scroll Offsets')
        .fontSize(18)
        .fontColor(Color.Black)

      Text(`X Offset: ${this.currentXOffset}`)
        .fontSize(16)
        .fontColor(Color.Black)
        .margin({ top: 10 })

      Text(`Y Offset: ${this.currentYOffset}`)
        .fontSize(16)
        .fontColor(Color.Black)
        .margin({ top: 10 })

        .width(200)
        .height(50)
        .backgroundColor(Color.Blue)
        .fontColor(Color.White)
        .onClick(() => {
          this.currentXOffset = this.realTimeXOffset
          this.currentYOffset = this.realTimeYOffset
        })
        .margin({ top: 20 })

      Scroll(this.scroller) {
        Column() {
          ForEach(Array.from({ length: 20 }), (item: number, index: number) => {
            Text(`Scroll Item ${index + 1}`)
              .width('90%')
              .height(80)
              .backgroundColor(index % 2 === 0 ? Color.Gray : Color.White)
              .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
              .fontSize(18)
              .margin({ top: 10, bottom: 10 })
          })
        }
        .width('100%')
      }
      .width('90%')
      .height(300)
      .border({ width: 1, color: Color.Gray })
      .onScroll((xOffset: number, yOffset: number) => {
        this.realTimeXOffset = xOffset
        this.realTimeYOffset = yOffset
      })
      .margin({ top: 20 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Start)
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Center)
    .backgroundColor(Color.White)
    .padding(20)
  }
}
